hero.label: Pour que chaque jour compte
hero.description: Frames you don't replace. Made by hands that refuse to take a shortcut.

excellence.label: What the House is made of
excellence.title: FOUR FIBERS. ONE CROWN.
excellence.description: Not words on a wall: what the House is made of. Four fibers that decide everything, and what they produce.
excellence.pillar1Desc: In front of every word, every image, one question: does it prove, or does it announce? If it announces, we cut it.
excellence.pillar2Desc: Titanium you bend and it comes back. Gold that doesn't flake. What isn't made to last never leaves the workshop.
excellence.pillar3Desc: We only promise what we can keep. Never on sale: a price that drops is a word taken back.
excellence.pillar4Desc: We don't measure a man by what he owns, but by what he honors. In our images as at the counter.
excellence.pillar5Desc: What the four fibers produce. What is well made can be repaired; what can be repaired is kept; what is kept is handed down.

fabrication.label: The workshop
fabrication.title: OUR
fabrication.subtitle: Making.
fabrication.description: Between Paris, Korea and Italy, our frames take shape in workshops where the gesture comes before the pace. Every step asks for a trained hand, a practiced eye. We don't make fast. We make right.
fabrication.step1Desc: Each sheet of acetate is chosen for its veining. The veining never repeats.
fabrication.step2Desc: Polished, reworked, checked by hand, until nothing catches.
fabrication.step3Desc: Each hinge is adjusted by hand. It has to hold at the ten-thousandth motion as at the first.

histoire.label: Our story
histoire.title: THE WORLD FORGETS.
histoire.subtitle: We remember.
histoire.description: Renaissance: meaning born again. A word for those who refuse to let everything vanish. To let the gestures be lost. To let beauty become disposable.

tryInStore.label: A chosen network
tryInStore.title: TRY IN STORE.
tryInStore.subtitle: Order online.
tryInStore.description: Some things aren't chosen on a screen. To know our frames, nothing replaces the gesture: trying them, feeling them, fitting them to your face. Our opticians receive you. The advice takes the time it needs.

allFrames.title: ALL OUR
allFrames.subtitle: Creations.
allFrames.description: Each model carries a Roman numeral, in the order it was born. The catalog reads like a lineage. You go back up it model by model.

reassurance.label: Our commitments
reassurance.title: BY YOUR SIDE.
reassurance.subtitle: Everywhere.
reassurance.item3Desc: We stand by what we make
reassurance.madeInFranceDesc: Made between Paris, Korea and Italy
reassurance.description: Advice, preparation, care: every step holds the same standard as the frame.

seo.title: Glasses that last. Renaissance Eyewear
seo.description: French eyewear maison, born in 2019. 18KT gold-plated titanium, Mazzucchelli acetate. Every pair carries its number engraved on the bridge. What you wear. What you hand down.
